/* cppi::4b69520eca3e589d20e26cd74c88975f9273b68da6d6f8d0026002a5677625c8 */
WITH analytic_pv AS
    (select sd.business_date, analytic_value
     from radar_reporting_uat
    .fact_analytic_sd sd
    join radar_reporting_uat.dim_hierarchy_node dh
on sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = dh.dim_hierarchy_node_id and dh.node_level=2 and dh.node_name ='BCPP' and sd.business_date = dh.business_date

where analytic_type = 'PV'
  and portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
  and sd.business_date = '2025-06-05'
    )
select ule.party_name,
       ule.gics_sector,
       sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure)                                 as credit_exposure,
       pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit as single_name_limit,
       case
           when ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit > 0 then round(sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) /
                                                                (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) *
                                                                100, 1)
           else 0 end as usage,
    CASE
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.949999999
            THEN 'Yellow Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) / (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit) BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.999999999
            THEN 'Orange Alert'
        WHEN sum(f.bcpp_credit_exposure) >= (pv.analytic_value * 0.01 * ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit)
            THEN 'Breach'
        ELSE 'OK'
END
AS status

from radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure f
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity le on f.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = le.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and f.business_date = le.business_date
         join radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity ule on le.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = ule.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit is not null and ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit != -1 and f.business_date = ule.business_date

         left join analytic_pv pv on f.business_date = pv.business_date
where f.bcpp_credit_exposure is not null
  and f.business_date = '2025-06-05'
group by ule.party_name, ule.gics_sector, ule.bcpp_single_name_board_limit, pv.analytic_value
order by sum(bcpp_credit_exposure) desc

WITH prev_business_date AS
         (
             SELECT
                 max(fact.business_date) as business_date
             FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
             WHERE
                 fact.business_date < '2025-05-27'
         ),
	current_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS country_code,
	      child.rtg_final AS rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook AS rtg_outlook,

	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
		  MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,

		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
		  MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	    FROM
	      radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos,
	      radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		LEFT JOIN radar_reporting_uat.ref_country country ON country.business_date = parent.business_date and parent.domicile_country_code = country.alpha_2_code
	    WHERE
	      fact.business_date = '2025-05-27'
		  and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		  and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
		  AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	      AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	      AND
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
	                parent.business_date = sibling.business_date 
					and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	    GROUP BY
	      child.party_name,
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
		  child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	      coalesce( country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
	      child.rtg_final,
	      child.rtg_outlook
	  ),
	prev_exposure AS
	  (
	    SELECT
	      child.party_name,
		  child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.rtg_final AS prev_rtg_final,
	      SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_st_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_mt_exposure,
		  SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS prev_lt_exposure
	    FROM
	      prev_business_date p
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
		    ON child.business_date = p.business_date
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact
		    ON child.business_date = fact.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
		    ON child.business_date = parent.business_date and child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      INNER JOIN radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
		    ON fact.business_date = pos.business_date and fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
			AND UPPER( pos.PRODUCT_TYPE ) <> 'NETTING'
	    WHERE
	        (
	          parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	          OR EXISTS
	            (
	              SELECT 1
	              FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	              WHERE
					parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
	                and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	             )
	        )
	      AND (
			EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
		  )
          AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
		GROUP BY
	      child.cppib_party_id,
	      child.party_name,
	      child.rtg_final
	  ),
	  child_level_exp_limits AS
	    (
	      SELECT
	        parent.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_parent,
	        child.cppib_party_id AS cppib_party_id_child,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.st_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS st_exposure,
	        MAX( child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS st_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.mt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS mt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS mt_smd_threshold,
	        SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN fact.lt_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS lt_exposure,
	        MAX( child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit ) AS lt_smd_threshold
	      FROM
	        radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child,
	        radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
	      WHERE
	        fact.business_date = '2025-05-27'
		    and fact.business_date = parent.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = child.business_date
		    and fact.business_date = pos.business_date
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	        AND fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id
	        AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
	        AND
	          (
	            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
	            OR EXISTS
	              (
	                SELECT 1
	                FROM radar_reporting_uat.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
	                WHERE
	                  parent.business_date = sibling.business_date
					  and sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	                  AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
	               )
	          )
			AND (
				EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
				OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM radar_reporting_uat.wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
			  )
            AND child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id != child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
	      GROUP BY
	        parent.cppib_party_id,
	        child.cppib_party_id
	    ),
	  breaches_under_parents AS
	    (
			SELECT
            	cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id,
            	MIN
				  (
	                CASE
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
                            THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                        WHEN st_exposure / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR mt_exposure / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            OR lt_exposure / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
                            THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	                    WHEN st_exposure >= st_smd_threshold OR mt_exposure >= mt_smd_threshold OR lt_exposure >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	                    ELSE 'OK'
	                END
	              ) AS status
            FROM child_level_exp_limits
            GROUP BY
            	cppib_party_id_parent
    	)
	SELECT
	  'Y' AS has_children,
	  c.party_name,
	  CASE
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.9 AND 0.9499
              THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
          WHEN SUM(st_exposure) / st_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

              OR SUM(mt_exposure) / mt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              OR SUM(lt_exposure) / lt_smd_threshold BETWEEN 0.95 AND 0.9999
              THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
	      WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
	      WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 'EXCESS'
		  ELSE coalesce( MIN( b.status ), 'OK' )
	  END AS status,
	  CASE
	    WHEN country_code = 'United States' THEN 'US'
		WHEN country_code = 'United Kingdom' THEN 'UK'
		ELSE country_code
	  END AS country_code,
	  coalesce( rtg_final, '-' ) AS rtg_final,
	  coalesce( rtg_outlook, '-' ) AS rtg_outlook,

	  SUM( st_exposure ) / 1000000 AS st_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( st_exposure ) - SUM( prev_st_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS st_change_exposure,
      coalesce(st_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS st_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate(st_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(st_exposure)) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS st_available,
      CASE
          WHEN st_smd_threshold = 0 OR st_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ) / st_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS st_utilization,

	  SUM( mt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS mt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((SUM( mt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_mt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS mt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(mt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS mt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((mt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(mt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS mt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN mt_smd_threshold = 0 OR mt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ) / mt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS mt_utilization,

	  SUM( lt_exposure ) / 1000000 AS lt_exposure,
	  coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate( ( SUM( lt_exposure ) - SUM( prev_lt_exposure ) ) / 1000000)), '-' )  AS lt_change_exposure,
      coalesce(lt_smd_threshold / 1000000, 0) AS lt_smd_threshold,
      REPLACE(coalesce(format('%,.0f', truncate((lt_smd_threshold - GREATEST(0, SUM(lt_exposure))) / 1000000)), '-'), '-0', '0') AS lt_available,
      CASE
          WHEN lt_smd_threshold = 0 OR lt_smd_threshold IS NULL THEN 0
          ELSE GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ) / lt_smd_threshold * 100
      END AS lt_utilization,

	  MAX( p.prev_rtg_final ) AS prev_rtg_final,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= st_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS st_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= mt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS mt_limit_blown,
	  CASE WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= lt_smd_threshold THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lt_limit_blown
	FROM current_exposure c

	LEFT JOIN breaches_under_parents b ON c.cppib_party_id = b.cppib_party_id AND 'child' = 'parent'
	LEFT JOIN prev_exposure p
	  ON c.cppib_party_id = p.cppib_party_id
	  OR c.party_name = p.party_name
	GROUP BY
        st_smd_threshold,
        mt_smd_threshold,
        lt_smd_threshold,
	  dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id,
	  c.party_name,
	  country_code,
	  rtg_final,
	  rtg_outlook
    ORDER BY
		CASE
            WHEN status = 'YELLOW ALERT' THEN 1
            WHEN status = 'ORANGE ALERT' THEN 2
            WHEN status = 'EXCESS' THEN 3
            ELSE 4
		END,
		ST_EXPOSURE DESC,
		party_name ASC

    select limit_name,
        limit_id,
        min(business_date) first_breach_date
    from "risk_prod"."limit_utilization"
    where is_breach = 'Y'

    group by limit_name,
        limit_id

    select *

    union all

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 11
		AND hour between 19 and 20
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 19:23:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

 FROM (

			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime

	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 00:46:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip

	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::3d020a0399273d2c87d892947a7c282064dfde96a2a89aaa7a5493a108de7469 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 11
		AND hour between 10 and 11
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-11 10:31:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-10'
)
select a.*, b.*, c.*, f.*, d.*, e.*, p.*
from
(
select 
  ss.model_portfolio_id as id_model_portfolio,
  ss.scd_holding_key_id as id_source_holding,
  null as id_enterprise_holding,
  ss.abor_security_name as security_name,
  ss.abor_security_number as security_no,
  ss.quotation_currency_code as currency,
  sec.abor_country_id as country_code,
  ss.abor_security_type_id as security_type_code,	   
  ss.abor_security_type_name as security_type_name,
  ss.security_group_id as security_group_code,	   
  ss.security_group_name,
  '48' as instrument_type_code,
  ss.abor_instrument_type as instrument_type_name,	   
  sec.country_of_exposure_code as exposure_country_code,
  sec.country_of_exposure_name as exposure_country_name,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_code as exposure_currency_code,
  sec.currency_of_exposure_name as exposure_currency_name,
  ss.balance_nominal_number as balance_nominal,	   
  ss.clean_price * ss.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency as clean_price_pc,
  cast(ss.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) as clean_price_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency as balance_cost_value_qc,
  ss.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency as balance_cost_value_pc,
  ss.balance_book_value_quotation_currency as balance_book_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_quotation_currency as clean_value_qc,
  ss.clean_value_portfolio_currency as clean_value_pc
from holdings.scd_holdings_main ss
left join RankedSecurities sec 
    on ss.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
where ss.business_date = '2025-06-10'
and sec.rn = 1) as a

left join
(
  select
    concat(CAST(h.account_id AS varchar), '00', lpad(CAST(h.security_identifier AS varchar), 4, '0')) id_instrument,
    s.scd_id security_no,
    s.currency deal_local_currency,
    concat(s.security_name, ':', h.account_number) deal_name_source,

    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_base_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_local carrying_value_local_cur_deal,
    h.market_value_net_base carrying_value_inc_adj_base_cur,
    h.market_value_accrued_net_local carrying_value_inc_adj_local_cur,
    (CASE WHEN trim(i.country_of_exposure) = '' THEN '' ELSE UPPER(i.country_of_exposure) END) country_of_exposure,
    i.currency_of_exposure,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_base_cur,
    0 as deal_commitment_amt_local_cur,
    i.developed_or_emerging,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_base, 0) distribution_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_itd_local, 0) distribution_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_base, 0) distribution_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_qtd_local, 0) distribution_qtd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_base, 0) distribution_ytd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.distributions_ytd_local, 0) distribution_ytd_local_cur,

    0 as multiple_base_currency_itd,
    0 as multiple_local_currency_itd,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_itd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_itd_local_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_base, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_base_cur,
    coalesce(cfh.paid_in_qtd_local, 0) paid_in_capital_qtd_local_cur,

  join reference.ci_sentry_issuer i on s.issuer_identifier = i.issuer_identifier and h.business_date BETWEEN i.start_date and i.end_date

      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Paid-In' then amount_base else 0 end) as paid_in_itd_base,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_local else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_local,
      SUM( case when level_1 = 'Distributions' and date(trade_date) >= date_trunc('quarter', date(business_date)) then amount_base else 0 end) as distributions_qtd_base,

    group by
      business_date,
      security_identifier,
      account_id,

SELECT 
  pos.*,
  dh.Department,
  sector.cppib_sector_classification_name_1, 
  sector.cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
  sector.cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
  sector.cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
  country."Country Final",
  sector.cppib_country_of_exposure_code,
  sector.cppib_currency_of_exposure_code,  
  dv01.dv01,
  cs01.cs01, 
  (top_level.top_level_pv*pos.benchmark_constituent_weight) as pv

FROM risk_prod.benchmark_positions_view pos

LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        business_date, 
        pv AS top_level_pv
    FROM risk_prod.benchmark_analytic_pv
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-09'
      AND benchmark_name = 'ATP CORE'
      AND node_level = 1
      AND run_id = 'ATP_CORE'
) top_level
    ON top_level.business_date = pos.business_date

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    cppib_sec_id, 
    cppib_country_of_exposure_code, 
    cppib_currency_of_exposure_code, 
    cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
    cppib_sector_classification_name_4    
  FROM asset.asset_security_enterprise_classifications
  WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-09'
) sector
  ON pos.id_cppib_security = CAST(sector.cppib_sec_id AS VARCHAR)

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT 
    country_code, 
    country_name AS "Country Final"
  FROM reference.reference_country_codes
  WHERE business_date = DATE '2025-06-09'
) country
  ON country.country_code = sector.cppib_country_of_exposure_code

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    benchmark_pos_id,
    SUM(dv01_value) AS dv01
  FROM risk_prod.benchmark_pos_calc_dv01
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(dv01) AS t(dv01_value)
  WHERE business_date = '2025-06-09'
  GROUP BY benchmark_pos_id
) dv01
  ON dv01.benchmark_pos_id = pos.benchmark_pos_id

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    benchmark_pos_id,
    SUM(cs01_value) AS cs01
  FROM risk_prod.benchmark_pos_calc_cs01
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(cs01) AS t(cs01_value)
  WHERE business_date = '2025-06-09'
  GROUP BY benchmark_pos_id
) cs01
  ON cs01.benchmark_pos_id = pos.benchmark_pos_id

LEFT JOIN (
    WITH sa_raw AS (
    SELECT
        node_path,
        split_part(node_path, '|', 3) AS Department,
        split_part(node_path, '|', 4) AS Strategy,
        split_part(node_path, '|', 5) AS Sub_Strategy
    FROM risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node
    WHERE business_date = '2025-06-09'
      AND hierarchy_type='SA' 
      AND node_level=4
),
filtered_sa AS (
    SELECT Department, Strategy, Sub_Strategy
    FROM sa_raw
    WHERE Department IN (
        'Capital Markets and Factor Investing',
        'Capital Markets & Factor Investing',
        'Total Fund Management',
        'Private Equity',
        'Real Assets',
        'Active Equities',
        'Credit Investments'
    )
),
temp1 AS (
    SELECT Department, Sub_Strategy AS node_name
    FROM filtered_sa
    WHERE Sub_Strategy IS NOT NULL AND Sub_Strategy <> ''
),
temp2 AS (
    SELECT Department, Strategy AS node_name
    FROM filtered_sa
    WHERE Strategy IS NOT NULL AND Strategy <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM temp1
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT * FROM temp2
) dh
ON dh.node_name = pos.category

WHERE pos.business_date = '2025-06-09'
  AND pos.benchmark_name = 'ATP CORE'

WITH RankedSecurities AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY abor_security_id ORDER BY business_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM reference.scd_securities
    WHERE business_date = '2025-04-30'
)

select h.*, mp.*, si.cppibprtyid, p.*, pe.*, '2025-04-30' as business_date
from
    (select
        h.model_portfolio_id AS id_model_portfolio,
        h.abor_security_type_name AS security_type_name,
        h.security_group_name AS security_group_name,
        h.scd_holding_key_id AS id_source_holding,
        h.abor_security_name AS security_name,
        h.abor_security_number AS security_no,
        h.cppib_sec_id AS cppib_sec_id,
        NULL AS id_enterprise_holding,
        par.party_name AS issuer_name,
        sec.abor_country_id AS country_code,
        sec.abor_country_name AS issuer_country_name,
        sec.country_of_exposure_code AS exposure_country_code,
        sec.currency_of_exposure_code AS exposure_currency_code,
        sec.country_of_exposure_name AS exposure_country_name,
        sec.currency_of_exposure_name AS exposure_currency_name,
       	h.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency AS balance_cost_value_qc,
       	h.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency AS balance_cost_value_pc,
        h.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency * h.clean_price AS clean_price_pc,
        cast(h.clean_price as DECIMAL(18,2)) AS clean_price_qc,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS clean_value_qc,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS clean_value_pc,
	   	h.balance_nominal_number AS balance_nominal,
        h.clean_value_quotation_currency AS current_nominal,
        h.clean_value_portfolio_currency AS current_nominal_pc,
       	h.quotation_currency_code AS current_notional_currency,
       	h.quotation_currency_code AS market_value_currency,
	   	cast(h.abor_maturity_date as TIMESTAMP) AS maturity_date,
	   	sec.abor_coupon_rate AS coupon_rate,
	   	sec.abor_interest_type AS coupon_payment_type_name,
	   	sec.abor_coupon_term_length AS coupon_term_length,
	   	sec.abor_coupon_term_unit AS coupon_term_unit,
	   	h.abor_instrument_type AS instrument_type_name,
	   	sec.abor_issue_currency AS currency,
        sec.abor_security_group_id AS security_group_code,
	   	h.accrued_interest_portfolio_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_pc,
       	h.accrued_interest_quotation_currency AS abacus_accrued_interest_qc,
	   	sec.abor_security_type_id AS security_type_code
    from RankedSecurities sec
	left join reference.scd_party_issuer par
		on sec.abor_issuer_id = par.party_id and sec.business_date = par.business_date
	left join holdings.scd_holdings_main h
		on h.scd_security_id = sec.scd_security_key_id
	where sec.rn = 1
	   and h.business_date = '2025-04-30'
) as h

left join

    (select
        unitized_pool_cpp_account_cash_code as pool_code,
        id_model_portfolio,
        funding_bucket_code,
        funding_bucket_name,
        program_name,
        country_region_name,
        canada_foreign_emerging_name,
        property_mortgage_reporting_name,
        gics_industry_sector_name_pi
    from finance_accounting.model_portfolios
        where business_date = date'2025-04-30'
    ) as mp
        on h.id_model_portfolio = mp.id_model_portfolio

left join

    (select
        cast(cppib_sec_id as varchar) as cppib_sec_id2,
        cppib_party_id as cppibprtyid
    from asset.asset_security_identifiers
        where business_date = date'2025-04-30'
    ) si
        on h.cppib_sec_id = si.cppib_sec_id2

left join

    (select
        cppib_party_id,
        domicile_country_code,
        incorp_country_code,
        party_name
    from party.party
        where business_date = date'2025-04-30'
    ) as p
        on si.cppibprtyid = p.cppib_party_id

left join

    (select
        cppib_party_id as cppib_party_id3,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_1,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_2,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_3,
        cppib_sector_classification_name_4,
        cppib_country_of_exposure_code
    from party.party_enterprise_classification
        where business_date = date'2025-04-30'
    ) as pe
        on si.cppibprtyid = pe.cppib_party_id3

where
    ((h.security_group_code = 'PI AGRI' and h.security_type_code = 'PI FARM FD') or

/* cppi::a98b4332ecc0aa6bef582bc5677658ef323669dadfbce020d5cb6854fd6a84ac */
WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",  
            parent.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_parent",  
            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",  
            child.party_name AS "party_name_child",  
                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-06-10'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'

             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS
            FROM
                    (
                            SELECT

                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST(total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND(CAST  (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_cash_pb_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_cash_pb_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_exposure,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(isrc_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (isrc_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (isrc_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_limit,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(smd_total_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (smd_total_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (smd_total_limit AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                          WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(der_exposure,'\-') and ( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (der_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (der_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN NOT REGEXP_LIKE(repo_sbl_smd_threshold,'\-') and NOT REGEXP_LIKE(total_cash_pb_smd_limit,'\-') and ( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) != null and CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL) != null and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL) / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( CAST (repo_sbl_exposure AS DECIMAL)  / CAST (repo_sbl_smd_threshold AS DECIMAL), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'

             ) p

            ), breaches_under_parents as (select cppib_party_id, MIN(status) as status FROM breaches_under_parents_tbl where state = 1 GROUP BY cppib_party_id)

                           OR SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit )
                           OR SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit )

                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) )

                           THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN b.status = 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )

                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )
                           OR ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) )

                           THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'

                           coalesce( rtg_final_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_parent, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "st_smd_threshold",

            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "isrc_total_limit",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

                           coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' ) AS "smd_total_limit",
             coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 )  AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )

                            cppib_party_id_parent AS cppib_party_id

WITH curr_exposure AS
            ( 
                    SELECT
             parent.party_name AS "party_name_parent",  
            parent.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_parent",  
            coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_parent",  
            parent.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_parent",  
            parent.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_parent",  
            child.party_name AS "party_name_child",  
                    child.cppib_party_id AS "cppib_party_id_child",  
            coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ) AS "country_code_child",  
            child.rtg_final AS "rtg_final_child",  
                    child.rtg_outlook AS "rtg_outlook_child",  
            SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND pos.days_to_maturity = 1 THEN fact.credit_exposure ELSE 0 END ) AS "exposure_expiring",  
            SUM(  
                   CASE  
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND  
                   ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                   OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                   THEN fact.st_exposure
                   ELSE 0
                   END
            ) AS "st_exposure",
            child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "st_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
             ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                           OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           THEN fact.mt_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "mt_exposure",
            child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "mt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p WHERE p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.lt_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                            END
                    ) AS "lt_exposure",
            child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit AS "lt_smd_threshold",
                    SUM(
                            CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                            THEN fact.credit_exposure
                            ELSE 0
                           END
                    ) AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category = 'REPOS' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.repo_fi_limit AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category = 'DERIVATIVES' AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "der_exposure",
            child.der_fi_limit AS "der_smd_threshold",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            child.der_repo_fi_limit AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            child.isrc_total_fi_limit AS "isrc_total_limit",
                   SUM(
                           CASE
                   WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' AND
                           (
                           EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'DERIVATIVES', 'REPOS' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) OR
                            ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and p.product_type_category IN ( 'CASH', 'BONDS AND MONEY MARKET', 'PRIME BROKERAGE' ) AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type )
                            OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wf_cr_exp_product_type_categor p where p.business_date = '2025-06-10' and UPPER( pos.product_type ) = p.product_type ) )
                           )
                           THEN fact.credit_exposure
                           ELSE 0
                           END
                   ) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            child.smd_total_fi_limit AS smd_total_limit
            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity child
            INNER JOIN fact_cr_exposure fact
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and fact.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_legal_entity parent
            ON child.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id and parent.chron_id = child.chron_id
            INNER JOIN dim_cr_exp_pos_inst pos
            ON fact.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id = pos.dim_cr_exp_pos_inst_id and pos.chron_id = fact.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country parent_country
            ON parent.domicile_country_code = parent_country.alpha_2_code and parent.chron_id = parent_country.chron_id
            LEFT OUTER JOIN ref_country child_country
            ON child.domicile_country_code = child_country.alpha_2_code and child_country.chron_id = child.chron_id
            WHERE
            child.business_date = '2025-06-10'
            AND UPPER( pos.product_type ) <> 'NETTING'
            AND
                    (
                            parent.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR child.is_fi = 'Y'
                            OR EXISTS
                                    (
                                            SELECT 1
                                            FROM dim_cr_exp_legal_entity sibling
                                            WHERE
                                            sibling.ulp_dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id = parent.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id <> child.dim_cr_exp_legal_entity_id
                                            AND sibling.chron_id = child.chron_id
                           AND sibling.is_fi = 'Y'
                    )
                )
            GROUP BY
            parent.party_name,
                    parent.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( parent_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code ),
                    parent.rtg_final,
                    parent.rtg_outlook,
                    child.party_name,
                    child.cppib_party_id,
                    coalesce( child_country.name, child.domicile_country_code ),
                    child.rtg_final,
                    child.rtg_outlook,
                    child.st_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.mt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.lt_cash_pb_fi_limit,
                    child.total_cash_pb_smd_fi_limit,
                    child.repo_fi_limit,
                    child.der_fi_limit,
                    child.der_repo_fi_limit,
                    child.isrc_total_fi_limit,
                    child.smd_total_fi_limit
            ),
            child_level_exp_limits AS
            (
                    SELECT
            'N' AS "is_parent",
            party_name_child AS "entity_name",
                    party_name_parent AS "parent_name",
                    CASE
                           WHEN SUM( st_exposure ) >= MAX( st_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( mt_exposure ) >= MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( lt_exposure ) >= MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( der_exposure ) >= MAX( der_smd_threshold ) THEN 'EXCESS'
                           WHEN SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) >= MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) >= MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) >= MAX( isrc_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN SUM( smd_total_exposure ) >= MAX( smd_total_limit ) THEN 'BREACH'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.95 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 1.00 ) ) THEN 'ORANGE ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ) / MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ) / MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ) / MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ) / MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) / MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) / MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) / MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
                           WHEN ( ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) >= 0.90 ) and ( ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ) / MAX( smd_total_limit ), 4 ) < 0.95 ) ) THEN 'YELLOW ALERT'
            ELSE 'OK'
            END AS "status",
                   country_code_child,
                    coalesce( rtg_final_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_final",
            coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '-' ) AS "rtg_outlook",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( exposure_expiring ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "exposure_expiring",
            CAST (ROUND( SUM( st_exposure ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "st_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "st_smd_threshold",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( st_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( st_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) , '-')
            AS "st_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( mt_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "mt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "mt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( mt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( mt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "mt_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( lt_exposure ), 2)  AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "lt_exposure",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "lt_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( lt_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( lt_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "lt_available",
                    /* Comment this out until GCM can handle these new fields after July 7, 2017 Abacus 3.1 release */
                   coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_cash_pb_smd_limit",
            coalesce( CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_cash_pb_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_cash_pb_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_cash_pb_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "repo_sbl_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( repo_sbl_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( der_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "der_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "der_smd_threshold",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( der_smd_threshold ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( der_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "der_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "total_der_repo_sbl_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( total_der_repo_sbl_smd_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( total_der_repo_sbl_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-')
            AS "total_der_repo_sbl_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( isrc_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "isrc_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "isrc_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( isrc_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( isrc_total_exposure ) ), 2 )AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "isrc_total_available",
                    CAST (ROUND( SUM( smd_total_exposure ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)) AS "smd_total_exposure",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-') AS "smd_total_limit",
            coalesce(  CAST (ROUND( MAX( smd_total_limit ) - GREATEST( 0, SUM( smd_total_exposure ) ), 2 ) AS VARCHAR(255)), '-' )
            AS "smd_total_available",
                    cppib_party_id_child,
                   cppib_party_id_parent
            FROM curr_exposure c
            GROUP BY
            party_name_child, party_name_parent, country_code_child, rtg_final_child, rtg_outlook_child,
    cppib_party_id_child, cppib_party_id_parent--, 'N', coalesce( rtg_final_child, '0' ), coalesce( rtg_outlook_child, '0' )
            ),
            breaches_under_parents_tbl AS
            (
                    SELECT
            cppib_party_id,
                --MIN( status ) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY LENGTH( status ) DESC) AS status
               DENSE_RANK () OVER(ORDER BY LENGTH(status) DESC) as state, status
             --MIN(STATUS) as STATUS

                    (
                            SELECT
